mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines > 1% MoM does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% MoM does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If a sustained decrease in FEDFUNDS does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strengthening economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the interaction of HOUST increase and UNRATE decrease does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If sustained increase in PAYEMS does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in GDP (GDPC1) and increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the interaction of GDPC1 decline and UNRATE increase does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
